description: Wetlands in Cambodia is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. This dataset contains information of land areas and location of wetlands in Cambodia which was downloaded from World Food Programme GeoNode (WFPGeoNode) using data in 2013 from the ASEAN Regional Centre for Biodiversity Conservation. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are Ecosystems, Environment and natural resources, Floods, SDG14 Life Below Water. It offers 7 resource(s) in csv, db_table, geojson, jpeg, kml. The portal shows 2019-10-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
